info.title: MiniBox API
info.description: Generated from the operation registry: boxes, snapshots, templates, the event log and agent API tokens. Sign-in, host and activity routes, and the event stream (GET /api/events/stream, text/event-stream), are not listed yet.

schema.description: Include current resource usage of running boxes. Send false to skip it. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: X-Minibox-Run
parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

400.description: Invalid input, or a malformed X-Minibox-Run header.

401.description: Not signed in, or the bearer credential is invalid.

403.description: Refused: a cross-site write, or an operation this credential may not run.

parameters.name: X-Minibox-Run
parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: Box name: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Surrounding spaces are trimmed.

template.description: Template image: repository[:tag] or a sha256 digest. Omitted, the bundled base template is used.

cpus.description: CPU cores, between 0.1 and 64, rounded to two decimals. Defaults to 2.

memoryMb.description: Memory in MB, an integer between 128 and 262144. Defaults to 4096.

profile.description: Security profile: standard, strict or relaxed. Omitted, the host's default profile is used.

ttlSec.description: Time to live in seconds. A positive integer, at most 365 days, or null for none. When omitted, none is stored, unless the caller is a token with a max TTL, which stores that cap. Nothing stops or deletes the box when the time elapses.

parameters.name: X-Minibox-Run
parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: New box name. The container is renamed to prefix-name. The workspace volume is not renamed.

cpus.description: CPU cores, between 0.1 and 64, rounded to two decimals.

memoryMb.description: Memory in MB, an integer between 128 and 262144.

pids.description: Process limit, an integer between 1 and 1000000.

labels.description: User labels stored in the spec. At most 32 entries. Keys follow box name rules. Values are a single line of at most 256 characters. Replaces the current set. Never copied onto the container.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Idle timeout in seconds. A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

ttlSec.description: Time to live in seconds. A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

Who made the call, such as owner.
Operation name, such as box.create.
Outcome: started, ok, error or denied.
Client session that made the call, as sent in X-Minibox-Run.
Only events at or after this ISO 8601 time, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z.
The nextCursor of the previous page. Omit it for the newest page.
Events per page, between 1 and 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: X-Minibox-Run
parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: Name shown in Settings. Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

preset.description: readonly, operator, sandboxed-agent or admin. Overrides below replace the preset's matching part. Omit it to send scopes yourself.

scopes.description: Replaces the preset's scopes. One or more of box:read, box:write, box:delete, exec, files:read, files:write, port:expose, checkpoint:create, checkpoint:restore, volume:attach, tool:install.

boxes.description: Which boxes this token may use. "created-by-me" (the default), "*" for every box, {"ids":["bx_…"]}, or {"tags":["env=prod"]}. A tag is a label key, or key=value.

volumes.description: Volumes the token may mount. "*" or a list of names. Empty grants nothing. Naming a volume also grants volume:attach. Shared volumes themselves are #24.

hosts.description: Host ids this token may use. "*" or a list. Omitted, a preset chooses: local, or every host for admin.

quotas.description: maxBoxes, maxCpus and maxMemoryMb cap what the token can create, as a total across its boxes. maxTtlSec caps the TTL stored on a box (auto-stop is #12). rateLimit is requests per rateWindowSec (default 60). Null clears a preset's limit.

expiresInSec.description: Seconds until the token stops working, up to 315360000. Null or omitted means it does not expire.

token.description: The bearer secret. Shown only in this response; the server stores its hash.
